Check to ensure that a Registered User can place an Order containing a CUG Discount:

Steps for "Check to ensure that a Registered User can place an Order containing a CUG Discount":
1. Go to BO
2. Open the "Promotion Rules" page
3. Add new "Promotion Rule"
4. Add "promogroup-epson-gb" in "Website" field
5. Change "Priority" to 1 and save it
6. Open ‘CONDITIONS & ACTIONS’ tab
7. Drag the "Target customers" field from "Available Conditions" to "Conditions" column
8. Select the group that includes the customer in the "Customer group" field
9. Select the your own customer in the "Customers" field
10. Add some action (e.g. Percentage discount value = 50%)
11. Save and Publish (need to use another account)

NOTE: This test case can be applied to the specific users &/or groups
